caption: The drawing features a wooden cabinet illustrated in the center, colored in light to medium brown tones with shading to indicate texture and depth. The cabinet has two large panelled doors with visible hinges, a broad, protruding top cornice, and stands on short, bracket feet. The wood grain is visibly rendered throughout the front and sides. In the upper right and lower right corners of the drawing are two smaller line diagrams in black ink, each depicting the cabinet from a side and front view respectively, with measurements labeled in inches and a noted scale of 1/2 inch to 1 foot. The drawing is on a plain, off-white background, and at the bottom right corner, the name "K. MORRIS" is written.
title: Wardrobe
